items.text: Hermantown, Minnesota's city council passed all six resolutions for a Google-backed data center late Friday, after about four hours of public comment, mostly from opponents. Google still needs other agencies' permits, and three lawsuits are pending.
S&P Global cut Meta's credit outlook to negative, projecting negative free operating cash flow of $71 billion in 2027, mainly from leasing data-center capacity. It kept the AA- rating.
The flaw under most websites, day 11: still no real victim named. A third flaw is still unfixed.
